column62:
- Current age bracket: nominal age 1144 Ma, lomagage 1137 Ma, himagage 1151 Ma.
- Queen et al. (1996) dated the lamprophyre swarm by 40Ar/39Ar phlogopite, 1144 ± 7 Ma
  (Kapuskasing Uplift dykes, not paleomagnetic sites), and by U-Pb perovskite: 1143 ± 12 Ma
  (Wawa, sample LH87-10 = paleomagnetic site D9), 1145 +15/−10 Ma (Marathon, LH85-4B =
  site D15), 1141 ± 9 Ma (Slate Islands, LH91-8 = dyke D17, not used), and a composite
  1144 +6/−4 Ma for the Marathon and Wawa dykes. All uncertainties are 2σ. The nominal age
  and bracket follow the 1144 ± 7 Ma phlogopite date.
- Piispa et al. (2018) also compile U-Pb baddeleyite dates on the Abitibi dykes (1140.6 ± 2 Ma,
  Krogh et al., 1987; 1142 ± 3 Ma, Heaman, unpublished) and interpret the lamprophyre and
  Abitibi dykes as one pulse of magmatism preceding the Midcontinent Rift.
